chapter: Meeting Louis and the New Orleans bands
title: Returning from World War I and sitting in with Kid Ory at the 25
summary: Punch returns in 1918-19 to find Louis Armstrong, Kid Ory and others at the 25; he sits in, plays army numbers and blues, and impresses the band.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Well, about me and Louis, I'll tell you about that. Uh... I left the country in 1918, and I was 18 years old. I went to World War I, and when I came back, the first people I saw was playing at the 25, Louis Armstrong, Kid Ory, Johnny Dots, Baby Dots, and Bob Lyons on bass, and Lorenzo Starrs on guitar, so... You had to play in a drum?
Baby Dots, isn't it? Yeah, go ahead.

Oh, sure. Baby Dots. And, uh... So somebody made me acquainted with Ori. I don't know who it was, but... And he asked me to come up and blow some. This is... This is no joke. This is real. So I went up and blowed. I blowed me some army numbers. I blowed me some blues, and I blowed me some songs, you know. So they said, oh, yeah. And Lorenzo said, look out there. He said, you better watch out, say, there's somebody gonna get you. And Lorenzo said to him, well, let him get me. That's all right. I quit. I quit. And Lorenzo's gotta quit. But that's true. Yeah, he literally got mad, you know. But he... They were just joking, you know.
